preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(a) <= 10**5 and 1 <= len(b) <= 10**5 for a, b in zip(test_cases_a, test_cases_b))
preconditions.description: Length of each string a and b is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s) for s in test_cases_a + test_cases_b)
preconditions.description: All characters in strings a and b are uppercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: len(result) == sum(len(a) + len(b) for a, b in zip(test_cases_a, test_cases_b))
postconditions.description: The length of the result string is the sum of the lengths of all input strings a and b.

postconditions.expression: all(''.join(sorted(a + b)) == ''.join(sorted(result)) for a, b, result in zip(test_cases_a, test_cases_b, results))
postconditions.description: The result string contains all characters from the input strings a and b in sorted order.
